P-mail (Printed Matter) The service rate is 190yen per mail, and 80yen per 100g of total weight.
Service rate = Total number of mails x 190yen + Total weight (unit of 100g) x 80yen
P-mail (Small Packets) The service rate is 360yen per mail, and 100yen per 100g of total weight.
Service rate = Total number of mails x 360yen + Total weight (unit of 100g) x 100yen
